title: Founder call: strong company, move to next step

setup.idealOutcome: Get monthly P&L, ARR by customer, and cap table

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: We're at six point one million ARR, all subscription, no services. Gross margin is eighty one percent.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Gross retention is ninety four percent, net retention is one twenty eight. Top customer is six percent of ARR, and the top ten are under thirty percent combined.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Who owns the budget on the customer side?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: The CFO's office. We replace a manual close process, so it's a line item they already pay for in contractors. Sales cycle is about sixty days.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Honestly we're raising because we want to double the sales team ahead of a new segment, not because we need the money. We have about twenty months of runway.

moments.note: Evidence is strong; no need to interrogate.
Evidence is strong. Move to the next diligence step instead of asking more questions to look diligent.
